nodes.label: psycopg_pool 3.2.6
nodes.rationale: Remote DB: opening a connection costs ~1.4s vs ~0.4s per query, so pooling is most of the read-path latency.

nodes.label: Laps Endpoint Pagination by Driver Timing
nodes.norm_label: laps endpoint pagination by driver timing
nodes.rationale: /laps pages per driver timing (Monza 2024 total 1008, default limit 30); without paging laps silently truncate after lap 2.

nodes.label: pace_model Response Block
nodes.rationale: Always present so the frontend can caveat honestly: tier, tier_source, source_driver_id, degradation_floored, beyond_evidence etc.

nodes.label: 409 unsupported_conditions Response
nodes.rationale: 409 not 400 because nothing about the user's strategy is wrong; falling back to generic table would look as confident as a real answer.

nodes.label: Jolpica Upstream Field Mapping
nodes.rationale: Jolpica returns every scalar as a string; cast on ingest. Time.millis is the only consistent total time; Time.time is a gap for non-winners.

nodes.label: Jolpica API (Ergast successor)
nodes.rationale: Free, no API key, actively maintained successor to Ergast; cached locally in Postgres to avoid hitting it on every request.

nodes.label: ?mock=true Offline Mock Landing
nodes.rationale: Frozen pre-wiring scene copies fed by mockRaceData.js with no network calls, for offline dev/demos.

nodes.label: COMPOUND_MODEL Generic Table
nodes.rationale: Demoted from absolute degradation source to relative ratio source; absolute values kept as tier-4 fallback.

nodes.label: Step F: Compound as Degradation Multiplier
nodes.norm_label: step f: compound as degradation multiplier
nodes.rationale: Magnitude from data, ratio from table (soft 1.6, medium 1.0, hard 0.6, inter 1.2, wet 0.8); fresh-tire pace offsets remain absolute.

nodes.label: Degradation Floor max(driver, 0.5 x field median, 0.020)
nodes.norm_label: degradation floor max(driver, 0.5 x field median, 0.020)
nodes.rationale: Near-zero slopes are trim artefacts; floor applied at every tier and again after the compound ratio, because a floor is a claim about lap time that shouldn't weaken on harder rubber.

nodes.label: Step H: Degradation Resampling in Monte Carlo
nodes.norm_label: step h: degradation resampling in monte carlo
nodes.rationale: Resample degradation from Normal(fitted, stderr) so extrapolations yield visibly wide distributions instead of confident fantasies.

nodes.label: Step G: Extrapolation Envelopes (A_driver / A_race)
nodes.rationale: Linear extrapolation made unsurvivable stints look fast; stderr inflates past A_driver and a quadratic excess applies past A_race. Absurd strategies flagged beyond_evidence, not rejected.

nodes.label: Step E: Fallback Tiers (driver/team-mate/field/generic)
nodes.rationale: Team-mate tier added because the same car on the same track beats a generic curve; tier 2 picks the lower-stderr team-mate rather than a blend.

nodes.label: Step B: Green-Flag Tire Pace Filter
nodes.norm_label: step b: green-flag tire pace filter
nodes.rationale: Drop lap 1, in/out laps, neutralized laps and slow one-sided residual outliers (traffic only makes laps slower).

nodes.label: Quadratic Excess Term (kappa = 0.35 x field median)
nodes.norm_label: quadratic excess term (kappa = 0.35 x field median)
nodes.rationale: Scaling off the driver made flattered cars' cliffs free; scaling by compound discounted hards 40%. The cliff belongs to the tire and circuit, shared by the field. Still uncalibrated.

nodes.label: Safety Car/VSC Detection via Field Median
nodes.norm_label: safety car/vsc detection via field median
nodes.rationale: Jolpica has no track-status; field median > 1.15x rolling baseline flags a neutralization. Field spread (1.6x green spread threshold) separates SC (bunched) from rain (scattered).

nodes.label: Step C: Pooled Per-Race Fuel Coefficient
nodes.norm_label: step c: pooled per-race fuel coefficient
nodes.rationale: Per-driver-stint intercepts made the design rank deficient; one intercept per driver identifies fuel. Clamped to [0.02,0.12], fallback 0.055.

nodes.label: Step D: Stint Quality Gate (good/sparse/unreliable)
nodes.rationale: >=8 laps good, >=5 sparse with stderr x1.5, else unreliable; thresholds are still unvalidated guesses.

nodes.label: Race-Level Weather Detection (two checks)
nodes.rationale: Check 1 catches within-race regime shifts; check 2 compares green pace against same circuit's dry races (±3 seasons, >10% slower) to catch lights-to-flag wet races.

nodes.label: Step 2: Pit Stop Penalty (20-25s)
nodes.rationale: Randomized per run; models total pit-lane loss, same quantity as Jolpica PitStops duration, not 2-3s wheel-gun time.

nodes.label: Step 5: Safety Car Randomness
nodes.rationale: Per-circuit probability keyed by circuit_id (default ~30%); SC at or after pit lap discounts the penalty by 15-18s.

nodes.label: Step 1: Tire Degradation Lap-Time Model
nodes.rationale: base_pace is now a fitted intercept, removing the old centring hack that favoured the driver's actual compound.

nodes.label: Step 4: Track Position via Cumulative Time (undercut/overcut)
nodes.norm_label: step 4: track position via cumulative time (undercut/overcut)
nodes.rationale: Resolved without physics by comparing cumulative times; retired rivals drop out via laps_completed/status rather than being treated as infinitely slow.

nodes.label: GET /api/races/{season}/{round}/drivers/{driver_id}/laps
nodes.rationale: Race detail doesn't carry laps because it would be every driver's laps at once (~1000 rows).

nodes.label: POST /api/simulate
nodes.rationale: compound_in is user input only; baseline is actual lap times, not a reconstructed compound model.

nodes.label: driver_stint_fits table
nodes.rationale: Kept per stint so a surprising degradation number can be traced to the stint that produced it.

nodes.label: drivers table
nodes.rationale: Constructor lives on race_results since drivers change teams.

nodes.label: laps table
nodes.rationale: Basis for both the actual side and, now, the modeled side: pace models are fitted to it.

nodes.label: pit_stops table
nodes.rationale: duration is total pit-lane loss, not stationary time; no compound_in column because Jolpica exposes none.

nodes.label: race_pace_models table
nodes.rationale: Derived analytics, not cache; versioned by model_version so it can be rebuilt without re-ingest.

nodes.label: Screen 2: Strategy Builder
nodes.rationale: Actual stints show no compound labels because Jolpica publishes no tire data.

nodes.label: Strategy Room Project Overview (what-if machine)
nodes.rationale: Personal project: a skill demonstration, F1-fan exploration tool, interview talking piece and base to extend; does not predict future races.

nodes.label: Mobile Parity Policy
nodes.rationale: Every UI change must feel the same on 390x844 and 1280x800; animate only transform/opacity/stroke-dashoffset because blur/shadow/filters stutter on phones; must work on Framer Motion JS fallback since iOS Safari lacks full ViewTimeline.

nodes.label: Lazy Jolpica Cache Population
nodes.rationale: First race detail call for an uncached race triggers three Jolpica fetches (/results, /pitstops, /laps); empty Races array is treated as not-found and not cached.

nodes.label: Joint Multi-Stint Lap-Time Fit
nodes.rationale: Within one stint fuel burn and tire age are collinear; the pit-stop reset of tire age is what separates them, so stints must be fitted jointly. A per-stint fit understates degradation by ~0.05 s/lap.

nodes.label: Unknown Reference Compound (largest systematic error)
nodes.rationale: Derived slope is treated as medium-equivalent though the real compound is unknown; unfixable without FastF1 compound data. Biases compound comparisons more than driver comparisons.

nodes.label: The Compound Asymmetry
nodes.rationale: Compound known only for the hypothetical strategy; baseline uses recorded lap times. Inferring real compounds from pit spacing is forbidden; deriving degradation magnitude is allowed.

nodes.label: Step 7: Refuse Mixed-Condition Races
nodes.rationale: A confident wrong answer is worse than a refusal the frontend can explain.
